coverage: Schematic connectivity review of inputs/project/rc_filter.kicad_sch: R1=10k between IN and OUT, C1=100n between OUT and GND, J1 pins 1/2/3 = IN/OUT/GND; cross-checked against work/netlist/design.xml and work/netlist/connectivity.json

Board/schematic consistency: pad net assignments in inputs/project/rc_filter.kicad_pcb and work/geometry/geometry.json match the schematic nets; GND return path C1.2 -> F.Cu track -> via (113,100) -> B.Cu GND zone -> J1.3 confirmed
Independent re-run of ERC (kicad-cli 10.0.7, --severity-all) on the candidate schematic: 0 violations, matching work/erc/erc.json (review-work/circuit/experiments/erc_recheck.json)
Independent re-run of DRC with --schematic-parity on the candidate board: 0 violations, 0 unconnected, 0 parity issues, matching work/drc/drc.json (review-work/circuit/experiments/drc_recheck.json)

Independent electrical verification of the stated requirement: ngspice-42 transient (1 V step via 1 ns PWL ramp, IC=0, uic, unloaded OUT) measuring v(OUT) at 1 ms = 0.6321204 V (review-work/circuit/experiments/rc_step.cir, rc_step_console.log, rc_step_out.txt)
Analytic cross-check: tau = RC = 1.000 ms exactly; v(1 ms) = 1 - e^-1 = 0.632121 V; margins +12.1 mV to 0.62 V limit and +17.9 mV to 0.65 V limit (review-work/circuit/experiments/analytic_calc.txt)

findings.condition: The only pass/fail requirement is electrical: /OUT must be 0.62-0.65 V at t = 1 ms after a 1 V step at /IN with the capacitor initially discharged. The supplied checks are ERC, DRC, netlist export and geometry extraction; none of them stimulates or measures the circuit, so a fully passing packet would not by itself demonstrate compliance.

evidence.locator: symbol R1 Value "10k" (at 86.36 63.5); symbol C1 Value "100n" (at 101.6 63.5)

findings.mechanism: ERC/DRC/netlist exit status proves rule and connectivity consistency, not transient behavior; a wrong R or C value (e.g. 1k or 10n) would produce an identical all-pass packet while failing the voltage window. Independent verification closes the gap: ngspice-42 transient on the exported netlist (R1=10k IN-OUT, C1=100n OUT-GND, 1 V step, IC=0, unloaded) gives v(OUT)=0.6321204 V at 1 ms, matching the analytic 1-e^-1 = 0.632121 V for tau = RC = 1.000 ms, inside the window with +12.1 mV / +17.9 mV margins.
findings.reasoning: This is a verification-coverage observation, not a candidate defect: the design itself satisfies the requirement under the stated ideal, unloaded conditions, confirmed both by simulation and closed-form analysis, and the netlist/board connectivity supporting that model was independently re-verified (ERC, DRC with schematic parity, and pad-net inspection all clean). Recorded at info severity so adjudicators know the electrical claim rests on this review's measurement rather than on the packet's own checks.
findings.title: Packet check set contains no electrical measurement of the sole stated electrical requirement (independent simulation shows the circuit passes)

limitations: Zone fill evaluated as saved in the candidate board file; a refill pass is forbidden on the read-only candidate, so fill-state-dependent connectivity relies on the saved polygon plus DRC results

Simulation models ideal lumped R and C per the stated scope; board parasitics, component tolerances, voltage/power ratings, loading and EMC were deliberately not assessed because inputs/requirements.txt restricts evaluation to the ideal unloaded step response and forbids imposing unstated requirements
The ideal step was approximated with a 1 ns PWL ramp in ngspice; the resulting error at t = 1 ms is far below 1 uV and does not affect the pass/fail determination
